verdict.rationale: Cactus is an on-device inference engine and fine-tuning platform rather than an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never mentions an MCP server or endpoint. The note that the platform can be run from 'a coding agent with your API key' describes plain API use, an adjacent capability rather than MCP, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
